ann.t: Outcome of Board Meeting — Paragon Fine and Speciality Chemical Limited has submitted to the Exchange, the financial results for the period ended March 31, 2026.

Resignation — Paragon Fine and Speciality Chemical Limited has informed the Exchange regarding Resignation of Ms INSIYA QAIDJOHAR NALAWALA as Non- Executive Independent Director of the company w.e.f. April 07, 2026.

Resignation — Paragon Fine and Speciality Chemical Limited has informed the Exchange regarding Resignation of Mr SHANKUMAR JIGESHKUMAR DHANDHARA as Company Secretary & Compliance Officer of the company w.e.f. December 31, 2025.
Outcome of Board Meeting — Paragon Fine and Speciality Chemical Limited has submitted to the Exchange, the financial results for the period ended September 30, 2025.
